messages:
Sam: PR 42391 — ready for final review. Need runtime + infra + security sign-off. Can someone own final sign-off and rollback plan? Hoping to merge in the 3pm PT window today. cc @Raj @Olivia
Raj: I can take runtime eyes, running perf + warmup tests now :mag:
Olivia: infra will check KMS touches and staging rollout config, ETA ~30m
Taylor: security can do a quick pass; any new auth flows or surface area?
Sam: no new auth flows, just header reorder in router. Local smoke passes: `./scripts/integration.sh --smoke`
Raj: perf looks fine on my machine, left two tiny comments in the review (non-blocking)
Olivia: infra is OK pending security sign-off. Note: confirm KMS key rotation impact — doc https://redwood/internal/kms-rotation
Taylor: quick security pass :+1: two nits on header validation, not blocking. good to merge once infra/runtime are happy.
Keith: i'll be rollback owner — will watch canary for 15m post-merge and revert if error rate >1%
Sam: great — assigning merge to Raj at 15:05 PT, Keith as rollback. tagging deploy-bot to schedule
deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy for PR-42391 at 15:05 PT — watcher: Keith
Sam: thanks all :pray:
